learning_outcomes.text: Explains measurement and basic unit systems.
Analyzes static, kinematic, and dynamic processes.
Applies what has been learned to Engineering departments.
Generates solutions for structures and problems related to static, kinematic, and dynamic processes.
Models static, kinematic, and dynamic processes and solves these models.
Applies the fundamental laws of physics to mechanical systems.
Acquires knowledge about vectors and vector operations.
Can distinguish the basic principles of one-dimensional and multi-dimensional motion.
Learns and verifies Newton's Rules and Laws of Motion.
Can distinguish work and energy concepts and apply them to problems.
Learns and can analyze the rotational motion of a rigid body.
Learns and can analyze momentum, conservation of momentum, and collisions.

syllabus_topics: Motion in two and three dimensions
Potential energy and conservation of energy
Center of mass and linear momentum
Collision and conservation of linear momentum
Applications of Newton's Laws of Motion
